chunks: Say: Travel on the earth and see how He originated creation. Then (you will know) how God will raise the last raising (of the dead). Surely God has power over everything,
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of observing creation in the Quran regarding resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked with 29:20 to emphasize that observing the 'beginning' (al-bada') of creation serves as empirical proof for the 'later creation' (an-nash'ah al-akhira), specifically the Resurrection. Scholars highlight the transition from physical observation to metaphysical certainty, affirming that the same Divine Power capable of initial formation is fully capable of reconstituting the soul after death.
